summary: 38 items, heavily skewed toward sub-variants (egg-noodle, fideo, gnocchi, ravioli, cellophane families) while the most common Italian pasta SHAPES are entirely absent: there is a generic 'pasta' parent but no spaghetti, penne, fusilli, rigatoni, farfalle, orzo, linguine, fettuccine, macaroni, tagliatelle, etc. as items. Asian noodles are also thin: rice-noodle, egg-noodle and cellophane-noodle exist, but ramen, udon, soba, somen, hokkien, and shirataki are missing. Couscous correctly lives in Grains & Cereals and dumpling/wonton wrappers in Breads & Bakery, so those are out of scope. Main work: (1) add the canonical Italian shapes under the existing 'pasta' parent, (2) add the missing core Asian noodles, (3) resolve the 'noodle' vs 'pasta' overlap (both alias 'noodles'), and (4) fix the misfiled 'vermicelli fideo' whose alias 'rice vermicelli' conflicts with its wheat-fideo parent.
issues: Comprehensiveness (Italian shapes): the dominant everyday shapes are missing as items — spaghetti, penne, fusilli, rigatoni, farfalle, orzo, linguine, fettuccine, macaroni, tagliatelle, orecchiette, ditalini, conchiglie, rotini, ziti, bucatini, manicotti, cannelloni, angel hair/capellini, rotelle. The catalog only has a single generic 'pasta' parent to absorb all of these.
Comprehensiveness (Asian noodles): no ramen, udon, soba, somen, hokkien, or shirataki/konjac items. Only generic rice-noodle, egg-noodle and cellophane-noodle exist.

Comprehensiveness (fresh vs dried): the catalog conflates a generic dried 'pasta' parent with a separate Refrigerated 'ravioli/tortellini' fresh family, but there is no 'fresh pasta'/'fresh egg pasta' item and no spaghetti/penne/etc. that a user could mark as fresh vs dried.

Parent/child: the 'pasta' top-level item has NO children even though it is clearly intended as the umbrella for Italian shapes; meanwhile sub-families (egg-noodle, fideo, gnocchi, ravioli, tortellini, cellophane-noodle, rice-noodle) are well-parented. New shapes should hang off 'pasta'.

Redundancy/ambiguity: both 'noodle' (generic Asian/soup noodle) and 'pasta' carry the alias 'noodles', so a user typing 'noodles' is ambiguous. 'noodle' should keep 'noodles'; remove 'noodles' from 'pasta' aliases (it already has 'pasta','pastas','italian pasta').

Misfiling: 'vermicelli' (id=vermicelli, name='vermicelli fideo', parent=fideo) is a WHEAT fideo product but carries alias 'rice vermicelli' — rice vermicelli is a separate rice-noodle product and should not be an alias here. Either drop the alias or split a distinct rice-vermicelli item under rice-noodle.

Well-formedness: 'gnocchi' and all its children default to storage='Pantry' with Pantry freshness [90,180], but shelf-stable vacuum-packed gnocchi is the common Pantry form while fresh gnocchi is refrigerated — the [90,180] Pantry range is plausible for shelf-stable but the family lacks a clear fresh-vs-shelf-stable distinction (minor).

Naming consistency: sub-variants are named as '<x> egg noodle' / '<x> fideo' / '<x> gnocchi' (e.g. 'nidi egg noodle', 'coiled fideo', 'jewish style egg noodle'), which is verbose and inconsistent with how shoppers name them; consider display names like 'nidi (egg noodle nests)'. Functional but worth noting.

Dietary tags: 'egg-noodle' and its children should NOT be Vegan (they contain egg); confirm tags. cellophane-noodle is correctly Vegan/GF. Soba (to be added) is typically wheat+buckwheat and is NOT gluten-free unless 100% buckwheat.
redundancies: Both carry the alias 'noodles'. 'noodle' is the generic Asian/soup-noodle umbrella; 'pasta' is the Italian umbrella. Keep 'noodles' on 'noodle' only; remove it from 'pasta'.
'vermicelli fideo' (a wheat fideo) aliases 'rice vermicelli', but rice vermicelli belongs to the rice-noodle family. Overlapping alias creates a false match.
'meat-ravioli' carries alias 'meat tortellini' which actually describes a tortellini, not a ravioli; tortellini already exists as its own parent with 'sausage-tortellini'. Move/normalize that alias.

cleanups.fix: Remove the alias 'noodles' (kept on the 'noodle' item) to resolve the cross-item collision; pasta already has 'pasta','pastas','italian pasta'.

Remove alias 'rice vermicelli' — this item is a WHEAT fideo. Rice vermicelli is being added as its own item under rice-noodle. Consider renaming display name from 'vermicelli fideo' to just 'vermicelli (fideo)' for clarity.
Drop the alias 'meat tortellini' (it describes a tortellini, not a ravioli; tortellini family already covers it).
Has alias 'tortellinis' which duplicates the generic 'tortellini' parent's alias — remove from the child to avoid matching every tortellini variant to sausage.
Verify dietaryTags exclude Vegan (egg noodles contain egg); they should be Vegetarian/Nut-Free, not Vegan/Dairy-Free-only without egg consideration.
This generic 'noodle' item is now the parent for ramen/udon/soba/somen/hokkien/shirataki additions; confirm its role as the Asian-noodle umbrella and keep alias 'noodles' here.
